topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: The space where my childhood tree once stood now cradles a silence, a gentle emptiness that seems to echo the way time breathes in and out. Each ring of that tree, now gone, held stories—whispers of sunlit afternoons and the secrets of growing up. I trace the outline of its absence with my eyes, and in its place, a new tale begins to weave itself. The earth, rich and dark, promises that life finds a way to speak, even when words are cut short. Seeds of new beginnings lie dormant, waiting for the warmth to stir them. The loss is a canvas, open and vast, inviting the dance of what will be.
